context: Render the note on the evidence line (or an indented continuation when it is long) without changing get_finding or the --json payload, which are already correct. Add a regression test asserting the note appears in human output, since the existing tests only exercised --json.
description:
_print_finding (_project/scripts/todo_findings.py) prints each evidence row as path, optional line range, and pattern -- but never the 'note' field. get_finding selects note and 'show --json' does emit it, so the data is present and only the human-readable rendering hides it. An agent triaging with the default 'todo finding show <id>' therefore cannot see evidence notes at all, which matters because the note is where the reviewer explains WHY a path is evidence.

Small and fully independent of the v4 migration, so it ships without waiting on any production gate. Kept as its own item rather than folded into findings-schema-v4-lossless-legacy-fields precisely so it is not stranded behind that item's authorization gate.

anti_patterns.dont: Change get_finding's SELECT or the --json payload shape
anti_patterns.instead: change only the _print_finding rendering and assert the JSON stays unchanged
anti_patterns.why: both already include note; the defect is display-only, and altering the JSON would break any consumer pinned to it

anti_patterns.dont: Mark the new or edited test module 'fast'
anti_patterns.instead: use 'unit' and 'medium' markers and confirm with the timing policy check
anti_patterns.why: the fast-lane cap in _project/config/fast_test_lane_policy.json has near-zero headroom and CI's timing_policy_check --strict trips on any fast-lane addition

preserves.behavior: Evidence lines without a note render exactly as they do today (no trailing separator or empty field)
todo finding show --json output is byte-identical to today's

verifications.description: findings script tests pass, including a case asserting the evidence note reaches human output

work_units.evidence: _print_finding now renders an indented 'note:' continuation; TestShowRendersEvidenceNote covers a note-bearing row, a note-less row (asserted byte-identical to before), and the unchanged JSON payload. 59 passed in test_todo_findings.py.
work_units.summary: Render the evidence note in _print_finding and add the regression test covering both a note-bearing and a note-less evidence row
